summary.text: Mickey Dollens is a Democrat who represents Oklahoma House District 93, a seat he won in November 2016. His House biography describes him as the House Minority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Dollens was born and raised in Bartlesville, Oklahoma, in 1987.
After high school he attended SMU, where he studied English on a football scholarship, and he was later recruited to the U.S. bobsled team.
He then worked as a roughneck in the Oklahoma oilfield before becoming a ninth-grade English teacher at U.S. Grant High School in south Oklahoma City.
Dollens won the Democratic primary with over 90 percent of the vote, and on November 8, 2016, won the House District 93 seat with 59.84 percent of the vote.
He serves on committees including A&B Public Safety, Alcohol Tobacco and Controlled Substances, Elections and Ethics, and Utilities.
In 2019 the Oklahoma Democratic Veterans honored him with their Legislator of the Year Award.
